parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing record is strongly protective: no trans-specific offence, self-declaration legal recognition, anti-discrimination and hate-speech law explicitly covering gender identity/expression, a hate-crime framework including trans motivation, and a state response to the 2022 Pride shooting at the maximum available penalty. Social climate is documented as generally liberal with hostility concentrated among extremists. Deductions come from enforcement friction: reports rose while clearance fell (52%→45%), only 8% of victims report (with documented dismissive treatment), tabloid anti-trans content, and organised anti-trans groups. Gender-care gatekeeping and record gaps on border/facility practice are resident-facing or open questions, not documented exposures. Net: acceptance plus mostly-working protection, but imperfect remedies keep it below the 0.85–0.95 tier.
